articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Alibaba Weighs DeepSeek AI Stake As Social Commerce Role Expands. Alibaba Group Holding (NYSE:BABA) is reported to be in talks with Tencent to invest in Chinese AI startup DeepSeek, aiming to reinforce each group’s position in the local AI market. At the same time, Alibaba is expanding its role in China’s social and instant commerce segments, where shopping is closely tied to social media and rapid delivery services.
